name: Kick

beschreibung.text: Punchy kick: a sine with a fast exponential pitch drop, short body, noise click, saturation and compression.

notiz: Source rule: recipe card `drums.kick`, Snoman [B3] p. 440–441. Measured by `tests/rezepte.rs`, not yet heard. Manifest character words outside the vocabulary: sub (as deep), boomy (as thick). Manifest use words outside the vocabulary: groove (as drop).
